kayla (Partnerships): Heads-up: Santara just approved our bundle for their Cloud Marketplace listing and will include Redwood Private as an optional addon for their enterprise image. Big win! :tada:

dan (Sales): Nice! Any pilot terms or expected volume?

kayla (Partnerships): Pilot: 90 days, up to 40 nodes, initial ARR motion small but with good expansion potential. They want a short technical blurb + onboarding doc.

maria (Partner Success): I'll run onboarding and request SSO + device cert rotation details. Need a dedicated channel with Santara's PMs.

pete (Eng): We'll provide a minimal `agent.conf` and enrollment curl. Also note we require outbound TLS to api.redwood.ai:443 and port 8443 open for agent.

santara-ci-bot: marketplace build 2026-03-04T08:11:02Z  bundle validation: PASS

lena (Marketing): Can we capture a 1-sentence quote at kickoff and a small architecture diagram? We should hold external announcement until metrics look stable.

dan (Sales): Marking CRM opportunity as "Marketplace Pilot - Santara" and tagging AE for renewal strategy.

kayla (Partnerships): Created private channel `#santara-redwood` and invited core folks. Next: pete to drop sample config and enrollment steps by EOD, maria to schedule kickoff, lena to draft partner blurb. Thanks team! :rocket:
